messages:
erin: Heads-up — starting a focused upgrade sweep in us-west-2 to exercise a few kernel + driver combos and see if ECC/Xid rates drop. Planning small sample: 8 nodes, mixed A100/RTX. Will drain low-priority tenants tonight 22:00 PT.

sam: Which combos are you planning to run? kernel versions + driver builds?

erin: Target matrix: kernel 5.15.114 vs 6.1.45, nvidia driver 525.116 and 535.54. We'll also test latest nv_firmware 54.3. Trying to avoid broad rollout until we get telemetry.

mohit: I pushed a short test harness to infra/test-gpu-sweep: run 12h ML micro-bench + memstress + long-run ffwd synthetic to surface Xid types. Command: `./run_sweep.sh --duration 12h --log-level debug`

ops-bot: Reminder: drain requests must include `--evacuate=true` and will trigger autoscaler adjustments. Use `./playbooks/drain_node.yml -e node=<node>` to drain safely.

tyler: Quick note — last week we saw repeated NVRM Xid 43 on one RTX when pinning to 535.49. Logs below from node gpunode-07: ```May 4 03:14:12 gpunode-07 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00:00): 43, pid=3129, GPU=0000:af:00.0```

anika: Good context. For telemetry, can we ensure KV cache hits & batch-size histograms are captured? We want token-latency baseline pre/post so we don't regress perf while reducing crashes.

erin: Yes — dashboard plan: capture Xid count, ECC corrected/un-corrected counts, WDT reboots, and latency p50/p95 for our standard prompt set. Mohit will add the probes.

mohit: Added prometheus metrics: `gpu_xid_total{type=\"43\"}`, `gpu_ecc_corrected_total`, `gpu_reboot_count`. Also instrumented a synthetic prompt set under /e2e/latency-bench.

sam: What's our success criteria? drop in Xid rate by 50%? 80%?

erin: We agreed informally with SRE: improvement >=60% Xid freq or absolute <0.5 per device per week with no new regressions in tail latency. If neither, rollback.

tyler: Suggest running a 48h soak per combination and compare normalized Xid/hour and p95 latency. Also include a control group of nodes with current stable kernel/driver.

ops-bot: Drain complete for nodes: gpunode-01 gpunode-03 gpunode-07 gpunode-08 — maintenance window started 2024-05-04T22:00:00Z.

erin: Plan for owners: moh it -> metrics + harness, sam -> rollout automation and gating, tyler -> log aggregation rules & alert tweaks, anika -> perf dashboards and eval prompts. I'll coordinate schedule.

mohit: Running first combo now (5.15.114 + 525.116) on sample set. Pushing logs to s3://redwood-ci/gpu-sweep/1839123456/comb-1/ .

sam: If we see a regression in p95, do we run bisect on kernel patches or switch driver? Which is easier?

erin: We'll prefer driver bump first (less kernel churn), but if Xid persists across drivers, we'll bisect kernel patches. Document everything in the GH issue I opened: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/issues/3122

tyler: FYI I added a quick parser for NVRM messages to extract Xid codes and correlate to uptime. Use `scripts/parse_xid.py --src s3://...`

anika: One more ask — please include NVML snapshots to see PCI link errors. Those helped us last incident.

mohit: NVML snapshots enabled for the sweep. Also setting node-level EVICT_PRIORITY to low for tenant migration.

erin: Cooling off period after each step: 2h stabilization, then 48h soak. If metrics look good, we'll expand sample by 4x.

tyler: I'll watch alerts over the next 72h. Ping me on @oncall if anything spikes.

erin: Thanks team. I'll post a quick summary after first 48h with numbers. :thumbsup:
